description: This Java test class verifies the behavior of the PlaceholderSubstitution component in the context of command modification for the Eclipse Ditto platform. It tests placeholder replacement in commands and immutability.

classes.name: PlaceholderSubstitutionTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for PlaceholderSubstitution, testing placeholder replacements and object immutability.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the test instance before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that PlaceholderSubstitution and related classes are immutable.

methods.name: applyWithNonHandledCommandReturnsTheSameCommandInstance
methods.description: Verifies that non-handled commands are returned unchanged by the substitution.

methods.name: applyWithHandledCommandReturnsTheReplacedCommandInstanceWhenCustomPlaceholderIsSpecified
methods.description: Tests placeholder replacement when a custom placeholder is used in the command.

methods.name: applyWithHandledCommandReturnsTheReplacedCommandInstanceWhenLegacyPlaceholderIsSpecified
methods.description: Tests placeholder replacement for legacy placeholder format.

methods.name: applyBlocking
methods.description: Helper method to synchronously apply a placeholder substitution on a command.
